//go:build linux && (amd64 || arm64)

package ui

import (
	"golang.org/x/image/font/gofont/gomono"
	"testing"
)

func TestOrbitFractionalPublicMeasureInheritanceAndCache(t *testing.T) {
	if err := RegisterFont(gomono.TTF, "Orbit UI Mono"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	on := true
	var plain, fraction float32
	view := func(c *Context) {
		sp := Span{Text: "Untracked fixture note.", Font: "Orbit UI Mono", Size: 12.5}
		plain, _ = c.MeasureText(0, sp)
		fraction, _ = c.MeasureTextOrbitFractional(0, sp)
		Column(c).Width(178).Font("Orbit UI Mono").FontSize(12.5).Children(func() {
			RichText(c, sp).Label("normal").FillWidth()
			Column(c).OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions(on).FillWidth().Children(func() {
				RichText(c, sp).Label("inherit").FillWidth()
				RichText(c, sp).Label("override").FillWidth().OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions(false)
			})
		})
	}
	a := NewTester(view, 400, 300)
	b := NewTester(view, 400, 300)
	for i := 0; i < 6; i++ {
		on = i%2 == 0
		a.Frame()
		b.Frame()
		normal, _ := a.Find("normal")
		inherited, _ := a.Find("inherit")
		override, _ := a.Find("override")
		if plain <= fraction {
			t.Fatal("measurement not fractional")
		}
		if normal.H != override.H {
			t.Fatal("inherited policy leaked into explicit false")
		}
		if on && inherited.H >= normal.H {
			t.Fatal("enabled row should fit", inherited, normal)
		}
		if !on && inherited.H != normal.H {
			t.Fatal("cache failed policy toggle")
		}
		other, _ := b.Find("inherit")
		if other.H != inherited.H {
			t.Fatal("two-window mismatch")
		}
	}
}

func TestOrbitFractionalSelectionAndLongLineResize(t *testing.T) {
	if err := RegisterFont(gomono.TTF, "Orbit Select Mono"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	text := "Latin fi é 中文🙂 العربية tail"
	width := float32(178)
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		Column(c).Width(width).OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions(true).Font("Orbit Select Mono").FontSize(12.5).Selectable().Children(func() {
			RichText(c, Span{Text: text[:8]}, Span{Text: text[8:], Color: RGB(200, 50, 60)}).Label("mixed").FillWidth()
		})
	}, 400, 300)
	for _, w := range []float32{178, 90, 320, 178} {
		width = w
		tt.Frame()
		selectBetween(t, tt, text, 0, text, len([]rune(text)))
		tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
		if tt.Clipboard() != text {
			t.Fatalf("copy at width %g lost content %q", w, tt.Clipboard())
		}
		if _, ok := tt.Find("mixed"); !ok {
			t.Fatal("missing text")
		}
		tt.Image()
	}
}

func TestOrbitFractionalEditableCaretAndDefaultNeighbor(t *testing.T) {
	if err := RegisterFont(gomono.TTF, "Orbit Edit Mono"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	value := "0123456789"
	other := "unchanged"
	tt := NewTester(func(c *Context) {
		Column(c).Children(func() {
			TextInput(c, &value).Label("fraction-input").Font("Orbit Edit Mono").FontSize(12.5).OrbitFractionalGlyphPositions(true).AutoFocus()
			TextInput(c, &other).Label("default-input").Font("Orbit Edit Mono").FontSize(12.5)
		})
	}, 400, 160)
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyA)
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	if tt.Clipboard() != value {
		t.Fatal("opt-in input select/copy")
	}
	tt.Type("中文🙂")
	tt.Key(0, KeyLeft)
	tt.Type("X")
	if value != "中文X🙂" || other != "unchanged" {
		t.Fatalf("caret/edit mismatch %q %q", value, other)
	}
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyA)
	tt.Key(Cmd, KeyC)
	if tt.Clipboard() != value {
		t.Fatal("mixed opt-in copy")
	}
}
